init_TwoFrameSfm: create a TwoFrameSfm instance with config, intrinsics, model, covariance level, and network size
handle_frame: process an RGB frame to initialize reference or align against existing keyframe pose
get_img_gradient_pyr: build a grayscale image pyramid with x and y gradients for each level
align_frame: align current frame against reference using two-frame SfM optimization and return pose and depth
delete_init_reference: delete all initialized reference tensors and free GPU memory cache
